h:
AIT 的工作流程，需要 ComfyUI_manager。

为了方便安装 - 将其加载到 ComfyUI 中，然后打开 ComfyUI 管理器并单击“安装缺少的节点”，然后完全重新启动 ComfyUI。对于实时预览，将经理的预览设置为“自动”。
更新：改变了工作流程中的一些内容，现在稍微好一点=]

o.en:
workflow for AIT, ComfyUI_manager is required.

for easy installation- load this in ComfyUI and then open ComfyUI manager and click "install missing nodes", then restart ComfyUI completely. for live preview set the manager's preview to "auto".
UPDATE: changed some stuff in the workflow, slightly better now =]
